sources.title: ER-4iA | FANUC America
sources.snippet: The FANUC Education Series cell features the ER-4iA, a compact 6-axis robot with a 4 kg payload and 550 mm reach—ideal for hands-on training. Powered by the R-30iB Mate Plus Controller, it delivers advanced control, integrated i RVision, and an intuitive touchscreen i Pendant for easy operation.
